install: npm install -g @colbymchenry/codegraph@0.9.6 && pip install -r requirements.txt && (codegraph status >/dev/null 2>&1 && codegraph sync || (codegraph init --index && (git checkout -- .cursor/rules/codegraph.mdc 2>/dev/null || true))) && codegraph status

town_integration.description: Town-Hermes bridge (Spec 090) routes Hermes job outputs to Town operator inbox

env_vars.TOWN_EMAIL: Operator email for Town delivery (default: djschulz@gmail.com)
env_vars.OPERATOR_DELIVERY_DRY_RUN: Set to 0 for live email delivery; 1 (default) logs only

town_integration.phase: A (email delivery, tested and ready) / B (hard failure routing, in progress)
